description: This file defines the DataGroupService class, which provides methods for managing data groups and permissions within the OrangeHRM application. It interacts with DataGroupDao to retrieve and manipulate data group information and permissions, including fetching permissions for specific data groups, user roles, and API access rights.

classes.name: DataGroupService
classes.description: Service class for managing data groups and permissions in the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to retrieve data groups, permissions, and API access rights based on roles.

methods.name: getDao
methods.description: Returns the DataGroupDao instance, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: setDao
methods.description: Sets the DataGroupDao instance for this service.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for specified data groups and user role, with an option for self-permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all data groups defined in the system.

methods.name: getDataGroup
methods.description: Fetches a DataGroup entity by its name.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Determines API access permissions for given roles and API class name.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Builds a collection of data group permissions based on filter parameters, possibly merging permissions for the same data group.
